items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: Johnny Wiggs has a project Sunday and has a parade Sunday too.

ctx.x: No. No. It's a different era. Oh, yeah.
It looks like. Johnny Wiggs has a project Sunday and has a parade Sunday too. One of the white Irish Channel clubs as a little craftsman.
Is there anything more about, oh, one other fellow while I think of it, Tommy Ladner. I know you once mentioned him years ago. Oh, yes.
